description: Serve the portfolio locally and open http://127.0.0.1:9876/contact.html in a desktop browser.
expectedOutcome: The contact/resume page loads with the existing ambient pink and teal background gradients still balanced behind the content.

description: Move the pointer slowly across the top half of the contact page.
expectedOutcome: The green cursor-follow glow remains centered near the pointer but appears as a smaller, softer accent rather than a wide page wash.

description: Move the pointer toward each side and corner of the viewport, then pause over the page content.
expectedOutcome: The glow continues to track the cursor via the existing CSS variables without overpowering text or upsetting the static ambient gradients.

description: Scroll down the contact page while moving the pointer intermittently.
expectedOutcome: The cursor glow still has the original viewport-painted shrink/fade-off behavior as the body scrolls; it was not converted to fixed or page-relative positioning.
